frame.origin: Adopted Galactic Center / Sagittarius A* reference

axes.x: positive from the Sun toward Galactic longitude l=0 degrees; the Sun is on negative x
axes.y: positive toward heliocentric Galactic longitude l=90 degrees
axes.z: positive toward the IAU Galactic North Pole

frame.quadrants: Q1 x>=0/y>=0; Q2 x<0/y>=0; Q3 x<0/y<0; Q4 x>=0/y<0. Face-on screen left corresponds to negative Galactocentric x, the Sun side.

dynamics.method: axisymmetric differential circular rotation; no rigid root rotation

gaia.referenceEpoch: J2016.0 for Gaia EDR3/GCNS records; individual supplements preserve their source epoch
gaia.propagation: uniform rectilinear motion, capped at ±1 Myr; radial velocity required; unavailable is never zero

kepler.referenceEpochs: KIC ICRS/J2000 preserved; Gaia DR3 cross-matches use J2016.0
kepler.propagation: only Gaia-cross-matched full-6D records use uniform rectilinear propagation capped at ±1 Myr; all missing radial velocities remain null and static

staticPolicies.sun: model-integrated circular orbit within the adopted rotation curve
staticPolicies.hmsfr: model-integrated circular orbit where Galactocentric radius is inside the adopted curve; source astrometry remains preserved
staticPolicies.nearbyCatalogStar: Gaia uniform rectilinear catalog propagation only when full 6D inputs exist, capped at plus/minus 1 Myr; otherwise static
staticPolicies.thinDiskRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported
staticPolicies.thickDiskRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported
staticPolicies.armPopulationRepresentative: model-integrated differential circular rotation where supported; static arm reconstruction guides remain separate
staticPolicies.bar: static; no pattern-speed model adopted in this release
staticPolicies.bulge: static; no pattern-speed model adopted in this release
staticPolicies.stellarHalo: static; never rigidly rotated with the disk
staticPolicies.spiralArmReconstruction: static observation-derived reconstruction guide; not a material stellar orbit
staticPolicies.lmcSmc: static catalog anchors; never attached to disk rotation

samplePolicy.database: All Q1-Q17 DR25 targets with KOI/confirmed/false-positive flags plus deterministic MOD(kepid,40)=0 field sample
samplePolicy.renderer: Scale- and device-bounded deterministic subsets; catalog identity never synthesized

keplerSelection.footprintMethod: Convex envelope in the local tangent plane of all 200,038 Q1-Q17 DR25 target coordinates; angular observation-footprint guide, not a physical cone or volume

diagnosis.evidence: All deployed GCNS stars are within 100 pc of the Sun, so every scientific point lies on the negative-x Sun side. In the fixed whole-Galaxy browser view, the Gaia-only capture shows these points are distance-faded and do not create the current bright arm structure.

diagnosis.classification: bounded rendering risk, not the current overview cause
diagnosis.evidence: The 1,200 nearby catalog markers occupy a tiny Galactic region, but the runtime NearFarScalar fades them to zero at the audited whole-Galaxy camera distance. They may emerge only at closer LOD and remain independently toggleable.

diagnosis.cause: HMSFR footprint and arm fit coverage
diagnosis.evidence: Reid HMSFR measurements and source-bounded arm beta ranges are not azimuthally complete and must not be mirrored for symmetry.
Thin/thick disk and halo samples are approximately quadrant-balanced; the bar/bulge follow their adopted orientation.

Fixed-camera Gaia-only, HMSFR-only, reconstruction-only and representative-only browser captures show the expected scientific populations without edge clipping. The representative disk remains approximately quadrant-balanced.

The Kepler target layer is a narrow mission footprint: 12,719 deployed real records from an upstream 200,038-target DR25 table. It is independently toggleable and is not normalized with Gaia or tracers.
